args.subject: PHL label cleanup
args.body:
Hi June,

A note on the PHL label confusion, from Sofia Marchetti's request:

- Pellow Home Living was renamed from Covey & Lark on 16 Feb.
- Moss's coverage digest says a saved report still reads "Covey — Late Arrivals".
- That saved report needs checking and its label updating to Pellow Home Living so it doesn't show the old name.
- The Pellucid rows are the Gulf Coast terminal rows.
- The Pellow rows are the Mid-Atlantic home goods appointments.

Thanks,
Bettina Kroll
Coastal team lead

args.text:
@Bettina Kroll, I saved the draft to June Osei-Lark (joseilark@pemberline.com) with the subject "PHL label cleanup". It's in the drafts box for you to review and send; nothing has gone out.

It has Sofia's three bullets on the PHL rename and the stale saved report, plus your two lines: the Pellucid rows are the Gulf Coast terminal rows, and the Pellow rows are the Mid-Atlantic home goods appointments. It's signed from you.
